purpose: Runtime editorial and visual rulebook for vipinislearning technical AI carousels.
content_rules: Technical AI only; explain one mechanism, diagnostic, comparison, or workflow in plain English.
The Threads post has exactly three short lines: hook, simple explanation, and action line with 2-4 hashtags.
The post and all five slides must tell one story and use the same hook, mechanism, and payoff.
Slide 1 must create a curiosity gap that makes the reader want the next slide.
Every slide has one idea and makes the next slide useful or necessary.
Use a unique practical perspective instead of generic AI commentary.
Current model, provider, pricing, benchmark, or release claims require dated evidence and official sources.
For model comparisons, compare task fit and trade-offs; never claim a permanent winner.
visual_rules: Use the approved Ref Image handwritten marker language.
Use one visual focus at a time: big, then small bold, then quiet.
Use cream paper, thick black handwritten type, rough yellow highlights, pastel cards, doodle icons, blue bird mascot, pink takeaway banner, and black CTA panel.
Keep titles short and body copy readable on a portrait PNG.
preflight: Does every slide have exactly one idea?
Is there a unique perspective or useful action?
Does every slide make the reader want to swipe?
Is the CTA connected to the content?
Do the caption, keywords, and carousel use the same story?
default_cta: If this changes how you think about content, save it before your next post.
